notes: The SearchForAlpha Lab research workspace itself, not the public demo (slug alpha, .deploy/). Type is 'node' only because the pipeline has no Python type; the Dockerfile here is custom. waitress serves the Dash app hosted/server.py builds, with live Yahoo and SEC data and the Flow Scanner refresh thread. Behind the owner login (hosted/login.py): SITE_LOGIN_EMAIL and SITE_LOGIN_PASSWORD_HASH live in /opt/sites/alpha-lab/.env, and the app refuses to start without them. No broker: ib_async is not installed and lib/live/ is deleted in the image. Stateful: state/, results/, export/ and config/ live on the workspace-data volume (/data); config/ is refreshed from the image at every start except watchlists.json, ui_presets.json and param_history.yaml (hosted/persist.py). Replaces the old systemd service searchforalpha-dashboard (/opt/searchforalpha, port 8060, deploy.ps1). readTimeout 300s because an optimiser callback can run for minutes.
